METHOD. First I rebuilt the map independently from the table titles themselves rather than trusting it. Every old->new pair is confirmed by title identity, comparing work_notes/pre_renum2/appendix3_utility.md and work_notes/pre_renum2/appendix4_ceiling.md against docs/appendix3_utility.md: old S1 "Operating characteristics at reference thresholds" = new S4; old S2 "Triage-oriented high-sensitivity operating points" = new S15; old S3 "Decision-curve net benefit" = new S5; old S4 "Weighted sample characteristics" = new S8; old S5 "Sensitivity analyses - weighted AUROC" = new S6; old S6 "Parsimonious model trajectory" = new S13; old S7 "Subgroup discrimination, calibration and error rates" = new S14; old S8 "Depression-module (DPQ) non-response" = new S1; old S9 "Disposition of the pre-specified selection rules" = new S2; old S10 "Harmonization-correction sensitivity" = new S7; old S11 "Attempts to exceed the external ceiling" = new S11; old S12 "Pre-specified method search" = new S9; old S13 "Deep tabular learners" = new S12; old S14 "NHANES in-domain oracle by predictor set" = new S16; old S15 "Oracle by learner, with confidence intervals" = new S10; old S16 "Calibration with cluster-bootstrap intervals" = new S3. THE EIGHT FIXES, ONE BY ONE. For each I opened the named tables and applied the map exactly once to the pre_renum2 text.

1. docs/manuscript_17var.md:158. Now "(Tables S9 and S11 in Multimedia Appendix 1)" on "apparent gains from externally tuned variants did not survive leakage control". S9 is the pre-specified method search re-run; S11 is "Attempts to exceed the external ceiling", whose rows carry the "externally screened" marking the sentence is about (confirmed again at docs/appendix4_ceiling.md:27, "runs screened on external labels are identified as such in Table S11").
